intervals.quote: In this talk we present the Electron Capture 163-Ho experiment ECHo, which aims to investigate the electron neutrino mass in the sub-eV range

End: the January 2023 ECHo-100k paper says ECHo-1k 'paved the way for the current phase, ECHo-100k'.

physics_goals.quote: The ECHo experiment has been designed for the determination of the effective electron neutrino mass by means of the analysis of the end-point region of the 163 Ho electron capture spectrum.
physics_goals.value: Determine the effective electron neutrino mass from the end-point region of the calorimetrically measured 163Ho electron-capture spectrum

summary.plain: An experiment coordinated from Heidelberg that weighs the electron neutrino by watching holmium-163 atoms decay inside tiny ultra-cold magnetic thermometers. Its first phase, ECHo-1k, set a limit of 15 electron-volts; the next phase aims below 2.
summary.technical: Calorimetric 163Ho electron-capture spectroscopy with metallic magnetic calorimeters (MMC), 163Ho produced at ILL and ion-implanted at Mainz: ECHo-1k (72-pixel arrays, about 2×10⁸ events, m < 15 eV/c² at 90%) and ECHo-100k (target below 2 eV).
